title: Brand
description: The brand under which a product is marketed. An object rather than a string so that members such as a logo or a brand identifier can be added without changing the meaning of existing data.

name.description: Brand name as presented to buyers (e.g., 'Patagonia'). For products sold under the manufacturer's own name, this is the manufacturer's brand.

url.description: The brand's own canonical website, as an https URL (equivalent to schema.org `Brand.url`). A Business assertion that UCP does not verify: Platforms MUST NOT treat it alone as proof that a seller is authorized to sell the brand, and SHOULD pair it with verifiable attestations signed by the brand.
